interface.longDescription: Create and edit optical simulation projects using conversational instructions. Explore example systems, configure light sources, geometry, materials, detectors, and cameras, run physics-based ray tracing, and inspect detector maps, camera images, and performance analyses. Requires a Luminous Algorithms account.
defaultPrompt: Help me create and simulate an optical system.
Analyze the detector results of my ray trace.

name: luminous-algorithms
description: Design, simulate, visualize, and analyze optical systems with physics-based ray tracing through Luminous Algorithms.

review.commerce_description: Luminous MCP offers a free trial. Paid simulation usage and subscriptions, if needed, are arranged and billed separately on the Luminous Algorithms website. The plugin does not provide checkout, initiate purchases, or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission draft: optical modeling and ray-tracing MCP integration, company branding, external subscription disclosure, worldwide directory targeting, and review scenarios.
